therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: eNOS cofactor supplementation and enzyme upregulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: cerebral endothelial function enhancement and cerebral blood flow improvement
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Mean change in cerebral blood flow as measured by MRI (arterial spin labeling) from baseline to 16 weeks

context.investigator_commentary: ASL MRI data files were corrupted and could not be analyzed, limiting interpretation of the primary endpoint. The trial was a small single-arm pilot study with 11 participants.
